signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {R : Type u} -> {A : Type v} -> {B : Type w} -> {C : Type u₁} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [Semiring A] -> [Semiring B] -> [Semiring C] -> [Algebra R A] -> [Algebra R B] -> [Algebra R C] -> (φ₁ : B →ₐ[R] C) -> (φ₂ : A →ₐ[R] B) -> A →ₐ[R] C

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The definition is total over all composable pairs of R-algebra homomorphisms; no junk-value edge conventions are needed.

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (A B C : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Semiring C] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra R C] (φ₁ : B →ₐ[R] C) (φ₂ : A →ₐ[R] B) (x y : A), VTask.comp φ₁ φ₂ (x + y) = VTask.comp φ₁ φ₂ x + VTask.comp φ₁ φ₂ y

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (A B C : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Semiring C] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra R C] (φ₁ : B →ₐ[R] C) (φ₂ : A →ₐ[R] B) (x y : A), VTask.comp φ₁ φ₂ (x * y) = VTask.comp φ₁ φ₂ x * VTask.comp φ₁ φ₂ y

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (A B C : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Semiring C] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra R C] (φ₁ : B →ₐ[R] C) (φ₂ : A →ₐ[R] B), VTask.comp φ₁ φ₂ 1 = 1
